title: You Do Not Fully Utilize Transformer's Representation Capacity
abstract: arXiv:2502.09245v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In contrast to RNNs, which compress their history into a single hidden state, Transformers can attend to all past tokens directly. However, standard Transformers rely solely on the hidden state from the previous layer to represent the entire context. We show that this design creates pressure toward representation collapse and can degrade performance. To address this issue, we introduce Layer-Integrated Memory (LIMe), a lightweight extension that leverages existing key-value buffers and learns per-head, per-layer routing weights to integrate representations from previous layers. Across language modeling, synthetic reasoning, and deep architectures, LIMe improves perplexity per FLOP in the studied regimes and yields strong gains on synthetic tasks while preserving higher value-vector entropy and token separability. translated_title: 你并未充分利用Transformer的表示能力
translated_abstract: 与将历史压缩为单一隐藏状态的RNN不同，Transformer可以直接关注所有过去的token。然而，标准的Transformer仅依赖上一层的隐藏状态来表示整个上下文。我们证明了这种设计会产生表示坍缩的压力，并可能导致性能下降。为解决这一问题，我们提出了层集成记忆（LIMe），这是一种轻量级扩展，它利用现有的键值缓冲区，并学习逐头、逐层的路由权重来集成之前各层的表示。在语言建模、合成推理和深层架构的实验中，LIMe在所研究的场景中提升了每FLOP的困惑度，并在合成任务上取得了显著增益，同时保持了更高的价值向量熵和token可分性。最后，学习到的路由权重揭示了对局部和长距离特征的系统性复用，展示了LIMe如何丰富Transformer的表示能力。
tldr: 提出层集成记忆（LIMe），通过学习逐头逐层的路由权重来集成之前各层的表示，解决了标准Transformer因仅依赖上一层隐藏状态而产生的表示坍缩问题，从而提升每FLOP困惑度与任务性能。
en_tdlr: We propose Layer-Integrated Memory (LIMe), a lightweight extension that learns per-head, per-layer routing weights to integrate representations from previous layers, mitigating representation collapse in standard Transformers and improving perplexity per FLOP and task performance.
